preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 500000.

preconditions.expression: for n, s in test_cases: 1 <= n <= 500000 and len(s) == n and set(s) <= {'V', 'K', '?'}
preconditions.description: Each test case has a length n between 1 and 500000, and the string s consists of 'V', 'K', and '?' characters.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: for i, (n, s) in enumerate(test_cases): len(output[i]) == 2 and isinstance(output[i][0], int) and isinstance(output[i][1], list) and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in output[i][1])
postconditions.description: Each output line contains two elements: an integer and a list of integers.

postconditions.expression: for i, (n, s) in enumerate(test_cases): output[i][0] == len(output[i][1]) and output[i][1] == sorted(set(output[i][1]))
postconditions.description: The number of possible periods matches the length of the list of periods, and the list is sorted and contains unique elements.

postconditions.expression: for i, (n, s) in enumerate(test_cases): all(1 <= d <= n for d in output[i][1])
postconditions.description: All possible periods are between 1 and n.
